Below it place two yellow ticket-style boxes reading 'Giảm đến 50%' and 'giao không ghép đơn'. Show an oversized photoreal banh mi sandwich on a white plate sitting on a round wooden table. Add a white rounded button at the bottom center reading 'Đặt món ngay'. Technical style: photoreal food poster with composited city scenery, bright daylight food lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
